name: Sekhlo Schema Code
author: mubashirhassan

sections.description:
Sekhlo Schema Code is a comprehensive Schema.org JSON-LD markup manager designed to help you optimize your WordPress website for modern search engines, AI-powered search, and voice assistants.

Key Features

🎯 AI-Powered Prompt Generators
* Schema Generator Prompt – Get AI assistance for creating perfect schema markup
* Meta Tags Generator Prompt – Generate SEO-optimized meta titles, descriptions, and slugs
* Internal Links Generator Prompt – Get strategic internal linking suggestions from your sitemap

📋 Schema Management
* Multiple schema types support (Article, Organization, Person, FAQ, HowTo, Product, etc.)
* Visual schema editor with validation
* Pre-built schema templates
* Import/Export schemas
* Enable/Disable individual schemas
* Real-time JSON validation

🔍 SEO Optimization
* Custom meta titles and descriptions
* URL slug optimization
* Character counters with recommendations
* Live SERP preview
* Featured image integration

🔗 Internal Linking
* AI-powered internal link suggestions
* Sitemap integration
* Relevance scoring
* Strategic linking recommendations

📊 Testing & Validation
* AI Search Score calculator
* Schema validation
* Google Rich Results compatibility
* Testing recommendations

🎨 User-Friendly Interface
* Modern, intuitive design
* Tab-based organization
* Dark mode support
* Drag-and-drop schema ordering
* Bulk actions

Perfect For

  • Bloggers and content creators
  • SEO professionals
  • Digital marketers
  • Web developers
  • E-commerce sites
  • Local businesses
  • News websites

Why Schema Markup Matters

Schema markup helps search engines understand your content better, leading to:
* Enhanced search results with rich snippets
* Better visibility in AI-powered search engines
* Improved voice search optimization
* Higher click-through rates
* Better semantic SEO

AI Integration

Generate optimized content with our AI prompt generators:
* Copy prompts for ChatGPT, Gemini, or Claude
* Get professional schema markup suggestions
* Receive SEO-optimized meta tags
* Strategic internal linking recommendations

Additional Information

Support

For support, please visit our website or use the WordPress.org support forums.

Privacy

This plugin does not collect or store any personal data. All AI prompt generation happens locally in your browser.

Credits

Developed by Mubashir Hassan
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/sekhlo-schema-code/ directory, or install through WordPress plugins screen
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Edit any post or page to see the Sekhlo Schema Manager meta box
  4. Add your schemas using templates or custom JSON-LD code
  5. Use AI prompt generators for optimization suggestions
sections.faq:
What is Schema.org markup?

Schema.org markup is structured data that helps search engines understand your content better. It can enable rich snippets, knowledge panels, and enhanced search results.

Do I need coding knowledge?

No! The plugin provides pre-built templates and an intuitive interface. However, you can also add custom JSON-LD code if you prefer.

Will this work with my theme?

Yes! The plugin works with any WordPress theme. It adds schema markup to your site’s HTML without modifying your theme files.

Can I use multiple schemas on one page?

Absolutely! You can add as many schemas as needed for each page or post.

How do the AI prompt generators work?

The plugin generates customized prompts based on your page content. Copy the prompt and paste it into ChatGPT, Gemini, or Claude to get AI-powered suggestions.

Is this compatible with other SEO plugins?

Yes! The plugin works alongside popular SEO plugins like Yoast SEO, Rank Math, and All in One SEO.

Does it support custom post types?

Yes! The plugin works with posts, pages, and custom post types.

How do I validate my schema markup?

Use Google’s Rich Results Test tool or Schema.org validator. The plugin includes built-in validation to catch common errors.
